jess_marketing: Hey @eng-runtime — planning the launch post for next Wed. Need an audit-ready benchpack from runtime. Specifically: slice-level latencies for three cohorts (short/medium/long), raw sanitized payloads, the random seed(s) used, and cryptographic checksums so marketing can reproduce numbers. Also need p50/p95/p99 and 10 sample prompt->response pairs for the press kit. Can you confirm steps and whether we should schedule a rerun?
sam_runtime: We can do that. Quick Qs: which model variant exactly and do you want quantized metrics vs fp16? Also confirm cohort sizes and traffic profile (steady vs burst).
jess_marketing: Cohorts = Short (1-64 tokens), Medium (65-512), Long (513-2048). Use rdm-epoch-2026-v1 (quantized int8) as primary; include fp16 comparison if cheap. Cohort size = 1,000 requests each. Traffic profile: poisson steady ~10 req/s, but include a 60s burst window at 200 req/s.
alan_eng: To be reproducible we need: exact seed, a note if warmup runs are included, and the docker image digest for the runtime. Prefer: seed=42, warmup=30s, include docker sha.
sam_runtime: Plan: three runs per model variant: 1) warmup-only (30s), 2) production-sim (poisson 10req/s), 3) burst window (60s @200 req/s). Artifacts we will produce: 1) bench.ndjson (raw sanitized requests + metadata), 2) latencies.csv (per-slice p50/p95/p99 + mean/std), 3) sample_for_marketing.ndjson (10 manually inspected pairs), 4) checksums: `sha256sum bench.ndjson > bench.ndjson.sha256`, and 5) a manifest with docker image digest and git commit. Example command: `python tools/collect_bench.py --model rdm-epoch-2026-v1 --quant int8 --cohorts cohorts.json --seed 42 --out bench.ndjson`.
runtime-ci-bot: scheduled bench-run #1765436795 -> running on pool-c-3. ETA ~35m
sam_runtime: I'll drop the run folder path once finished: /eng/runtime/bench/runs/1765436795/ — README will include exact flags and the warmup/burst timelines.
jess_marketing: Please also include a simple reproducibility checklist for Marketing: commands to replay locally and the minimal env (CUDA, driver, python reqs). We need to hand this to partnerships and product.
carla_legal: cc @carla_legal - I'll need to review the 10 sample pairs for PII/brand safety before anything external.
sam_runtime: Understood. We'll sanitize (hash user IDs, redact emails) and add a column `sanitization_notes`. For public-facing latency claims: recommend quoting p50/p95 from the production-sim run on the int8 variant, and include a note like "quantized variant; see appendix for fp16 comparison". We will also compute a quality delta (ROUGE/BLEU-style proxy) and warn if quantization delta > 0.5.
jess_marketing: Can we get a rough smoke (summary p50/p95 + 10 samples + checksums) by EOD today? Final artifacts by tomorrow morning?
sam_runtime: Queue is medium. We can prioritize a smoke (warmup + short production-sim sampling) and push a rough bundle by EOD if you approve preempting queued jobs. Final full runs will land tomorrow morning.
jess_marketing: Preempt approved. Rough smoke by EOD is fine — thanks.
sam_runtime: Cool. I'll post the run link + artifacts here when ready. If anything changes to cohort sizes or model tag, ping me ASAP.
